findings.description: Removing the custom __reduce_ex__ breaks pickling of the UNSET and FLAG_NEEDS_VALUE sentinels, because the default Enum reduce reconstructs members by value lookup against the object() values.
findings.rationale: Trigger: pickling a value that holds Sentinel.UNSET, such as an option or context default, then unpickling it. Mechanism: the default Enum __reduce_ex__ serializes the member's object() value, and on load Sentinel(value) compares by equality against the original object(), which fails because the unpickled object is a new instance, raising ValueError. Impact: unpickling fails or the sentinel identity is lost, so 'is UNSET' checks stop matching after a pickle round trip.
